All 7 tests pass now. Here's a summary of the bugs fixed:

1. **`overlaps`** — used `<=` which treated touching intervals as overlapping; changed to `<` so touching boundaries don't count as overlap
2. **`merge_intervals`** — mutated the input argument (should not) and used `<` instead of `<=` for merge detection; fixed to copy the list first and use `<=` to also merge touching intervals
3. **`total_busy_minutes`** — summed raw interval lengths without merging overlaps, so overlapping parts were double-counted; now calls `merge_intervals` first to count distinct minutes
4. **`find_free_slots`** — cursor was unclamped to the day window (could exceed `day_end`) and used `>` instead of `>=` for gap detection; also missed the trailing gap after the last busy interval. Fixed clamping, gap threshold, and end-of-day check
